mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students_courses (student_id, course_id, course_start_at, course_end_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{courseStartAt}, #{courseEndAt})
mapper.select: SELECT sc.*, s.name AS studentName, bc.course_name AS courseName, bc.default_start_at AS defaultStartAt, bc.default_end_at AS defaultEndAt, bc.is_end AS isEnd FROM students_courses sc JOIN students s ON sc.student_id = s.id JOIN basic_courses bc ON sc.course_id = bc.id ORDER BY sc.course_id
